name: ISKCON Rourkela
town_description: Chhend Colony is a residential neighbourhood of Rourkela in Sundargarh district, Odisha, around 3–4 km from the city centre. The ISKCON centre at Kalyani Nagar Phase 1 serves the Gaudiya Vaishnava community of the steel city.

travel.airport: Jharsuguda (Veer Surendra Sai Airport) is the nearest airport; Biju Patnaik International Airport, Bhubaneswar is the nearest major airport.
travel.railway: Rourkela Junction — major railhead on the Howrah–Mumbai line.
travel.road: Kalyani Nagar Phase 1, Chhend Colony, Rourkela — well connected by city roads.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Janmashtami is the major annual celebration.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Per Justdial: 4:00 AM–8:00 PM daily (4:00 AM–9:00 PM on Sundays) — verify locally.
